text:
mai (design): quick sync
 thinking about the evals toolbar: proposal to change the approval affordance into two actions — "Quick pass" and "Sign off & record". Goal: speed for reviewers, audit trace for signers.

ben (product): what's the main user problem? accidental sign-offs or unclear consequences?

mai: both. PMs want fast triage; compliance teams want an explicit recorded sign-off. The current single approve is ambiguous.

samir (eng): backend ok with emitting a signed event for the record path. we should version it: evals.signoff.v1 and include signer, prompt_set_sha, type: quick|record, count. small storage change for snapshot on record.

rosa (a11y): a11y note: two similarly-labeled buttons can be confusing for screen readers. group them with role="group" and a clear legend. each button should have aria-describedby pointing to visible consequence text. Confirmation dialogs must be alertdialog with focus trap.

harper (uxresearch): in intercepts people used different language; "Quick pass" reads safe for triage. "Sign off & record" communicates permanence. recommend keeping verbs consistent with org language in beta.

mai: mock: primary small button = Quick pass; secondary = Sign off & record (opens compact modal). Tooltip on secondary: "Create an immutable audit entry with signer and snapshot."

ben: copy tweak: shorten to "Sign off + record"? keeps width down.

mai: ok to try "Sign off + record". include tiny muted help text under the buttons explaining difference.

rosa: tooltip alone isn't accessible. make consequence text visible and add sr-only extra detail. announce results with aria-live; ensure result panel gets focus. toast with audit id should be keyboard dismissable.

samir: shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = Quick pass, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter = Sign off + record. frontend will send `trigger` field: ui|shortcut|api in telemetry.

harper: surface shortcuts near the button for discoverability on first use (dismissible). users only pick up shortcuts when hinted. include 2 screen reader participants in testing.

mai: bulk flow: when selecting many tests, modal shows count and a short domain summary, not the full list. Confirm copy: "Sign off X items and create audit?"

rosa: extra: if record path chosen, show toast: "Signed off X tests. Audit ID: ABC123" with link. toast role=status and focusable. include aria-describedby on link.

samir: event payload sample: `user_id, type, prompt_set_sha, count, audit_id?, archive_url?`. For >500 items we'll archive bundle and return archive_url in event.

ben: rollout: behind org-level flag. default unchanged. enable for beta enterprise orgs first. track metrics: percent quick vs record, undo within 2 minutes, time-to-approve.

mai: QA checklist: focus order, sr-only descriptions, keyboard shortcuts, modal aria-role, toast with link, bulk summary trimming, contrast checks.

bot-ci: Created ticket #4981: "evals: split quick pass + signoff + audit" and assigned to samir.

ben: decision: move ahead with "Quick pass" / "Sign off + record" behind flag. add shortcuts and a11y callouts. beta rollout to one enterprise org first.

mai: action items: @samir open schema PR and branch. @rosa add a11y checklist to PR template. @harper schedule 6 usability sessions (2 SR). I'll update figma and post link. Target: start beta next week.

samir: ack, branch tomorrow.

rosa: will post checklist.

harper: invites sent.

mai: thanks all ":thumbsup:", will share mocks when branch is up.
